extensionDescription.message: Save selected words locally with a shortcut or right-click, review them later, and export your vocabulary as CSV.

tagline.message: A little pocket for new words.

emptyBody.message: Select a word on a web page, then use the save button, right-click menu, or keyboard shortcut.

shortcutHint.message: No shortcut is assigned. Click to choose one.

shortcutError.message: Open Chrome's extension keyboard shortcuts to change the keys.

previewUnavailable.message: Selection is unavailable on this page. Try a regular web page.

selectWord.message: Select a word on the page first.

selectionTooLong.message: Choose a shorter word or phrase, up to 5,000 characters.

sourceUnavailable.message: The source page information is unavailable.

restrictedPage.message: Use a regular web page. Chrome settings and other protected pages are not supported.

storedDataInvalid.message: Saved data could not be read. Keep the extension installed and report the issue.

deleteWordMissing.message: Choose a saved word to delete.

quotaExceeded.message: Storage is full. Export your CSV, then delete unneeded entries.

operationFailed.message: The action failed. Try again on a regular web page. Existing entries are kept.

loadFailed.message: Unable to load. Close and reopen the extension.
